record.title: Repair prelaunch input inventory
record.intent: Handle generated Python cache directories without changing the option experiment.
requirements: Commit tasking before execution. Preserve the failed run unchanged.
Hash source files recursively and fail on unsupported source objects; retain complete input coverage.
Exercise a host-only control containing nested cache files and a changed file. No guest launch in preparation.
Keep option fixture and stock execution semantics frozen; commit and push preparation before the next run.
acceptance: The input recorder handles generated directories and detects changed file contents.
